# Xoroh open-source hub

> The open-source hub of Xoroh (xoroh.org). Commercial SaaS lives at
> xoroh.com; this site covers community open source only.

## Pages

- [Hub home](/): projects (Kern, Axis), news pointer, domain table
- [News](/news): one stream for releases, governance notes, and security notes

## Projects

- Kern — One foundation. Every design system. Docs: https://kern.xoroh.org
- Axis — Unstyled, accessible behavior primitives for native. Docs: https://github.com/xoroh/axis/tree/development/docs

- Machine index: /search-index.json (hand-maintained per O-4; Pagefind only past ~50 pages)
